meta.name: high-end-visual-design
meta.description: Teaches the AI to design like a high-end agency. Defines the exact fonts, spacing, shadows, card structures, and animations that make a website feel expensive. Blocks all the common defaults that make AI designs look cheap or generic.

copy.tagline: 让网页设计拥有高端品牌质感
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让AI生成的设计摆脱廉价感、更像专业工作室出品。
copy.tagline_en: Make web designs feel premium and agency-crafted
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI-generated designs to look expensive and professional.

howto.what: Claude 会像顶级设计机构一样生成网页代码，使用高端字体、双边框嵌套结构、自定义动画和大量留白，并避免常见廉价设计元素。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 设计网页或生成 UI 代码时触发，尤其是涉及视觉风格、布局或交互效果时。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 SaaS 产品的着陆页，要高端质感。
生成一个奢侈品品牌的首页，要有编辑感。

howto.what_en: Claude generates web code like a top design agency, using premium fonts, double-bezel nested architecture, custom animations, and generous whitespace, while avoiding common cheap design patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to design a webpage or generate UI code, especially when visual style, layout, or interaction effects are involved.

say_en.text: Design a landing page for a SaaS product with a high-end feel.
say_en.note: Claude will apply Ethereal Glass vibe and asymmetrical layout.

say_en.text: Generate a homepage for a luxury brand with an editorial look.
say_en.note: Claude will use Editorial Luxury vibe and Z-axis cascade layout.
